title: 共鳴の回廊、鏡像の特異点
author: 鷹野 シン

en.title: Resonant Corridor, Mirror's Singularity
en.premise: In a world where humanity has reclaimed the "self" and emotions bleed faintly into one another, a state of "resonance" prevails. Yet the relentless noise of others' feelings drives many to madness, plunging society into new chaos. Kai confronts a new faction that champions the "Mirror Technique", a method to fully isolate consciousness and restore silence. There, he discovers a physical "lost letter" written before the era of cyberization.

zh.title: 共鸣的回廊，镜像的特异点
zh.premise: 在一个人类重新夺回“自我”，彼此情感微微渗透的世界里，出现了“共鸣”状态。然而，无法停止的他者情绪噪音让许多人精神崩溃，社会陷入新的混沌。凯与一支倡导“镜像技术”的新势力对峙，该技术能完全隔离意识，恢复寂静。在那里，他发现了一封写于电脑化之前的物理“失落信件”。
